tag.$description: A tag: a short word on a tint of its color, the system's `.ws-tag` and every implementation's badge, or outlined in a plain list. Five sizes, xs to xl; md is the default and the size of `.ws-tag`.

padding-block.$description: 2, 2, 4 and 6 px from sm up. An xs tag has none: its line is its height.

radius.$description: The same at every size, outlined too.

primary.$description: The tag: a tint of the interactive color.

success.$description: A status that went well, on the tint of a tip.

info.$description: A status that waits, on the tint of a note.

warning.$description: A status that needs attention soon, on the tint of a warning.

danger.$description: A status that failed or ended, on the tint of danger.

neutral.$description: A plain fact with no status, on the raised color.

outline.$description: The outlined tag, for a plain list such as a stack: the text color, roomier than a tag on a tint. Its edge is the border color of a card, which the spec names: it frames the word, which carries the tag alone, so it is not an edge of the tier, which has to reach 3:1.

padding-inline.$description: Inside the edge: 8, 8, 10, 12 and 14 px, 2 px more than a tag on a tint.

padding-block.$description: From the outside of the edge, which takes its width from it: 2, 4, 4, 6 and 8 px, 2 px more than a tag on a tint.
